bunker_locations: Canonical identity migrations require an inventory of every persisted row mapper, selector, sort, cache key, and display boundary.
Use separate canonical output and compatibility input types so legacy numeric inputs cannot leak back into stored or returned identity.
Migration tests must model the exact previous production schema and prove indexes, foreign keys, constraints, and data survive table rebuilds.
Coexistence fixtures should keep S458.1 and S458.10 live together so numeric aliasing cannot hide.
yardage_book_updates: Normalize authored sprint ids with sprintIdKey at read boundaries and retain the returned string as identity.
Use compareSprintIdKeys or roadmap-aware comparison for ordering; Number and parseInt are not identity operations.
Coexistence tests must include both S458.1 and S458.10 in the same fixture.
